checkedAlternates.risk: Hawaiian eruptions can produce tall lava fountains.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Hawaiian eruptions are low-viscosity effusive lava flows (group-1), whereas Strombolian and Vulcanian eruptions are discrete explosive blasts (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Peléan eruptions generate devastating pyroclastic flows.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Peléan eruptions are driven by viscous lava-dome collapse (group-3), distinct from sustained stratospheric Plinian columns (group-4).
